title: Improve quantized kernels: INT8/FP8 smoothquant + dequant fusion + scheduler alignment
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Reduce inference cost and latency for quantized model variants by minimizing dequant/quant transitions and leveraging model-aware kernel paths. This PR adds fused dequant paths for INT8/FP8 kernels, introduces optional smoothquant-aware weight transforms at kernel load time, and aligns the continuous-batching scheduler to favor quantized micro-batches for better GPU utilization.

Summary of changes: - Implement fused dequant + matmul kernels for INT8 and FP8 codepaths to avoid per-tensor copies and redundant memory passes. - Add one-time smoothquant weight transform applied during model load with reversible metadata so we can fallback at runtime. - Update kernel dispatch to select fused path when input dtype + layout + quant metadata match, with safe fallback to existing dequant + generic kernels. - Scheduler change: batch alignment hints to coalesce quants with compatible seq-len/prefix to reduce padding overhead. - KV-cache integration: avoid redundant dequant conversions when appending KV cache entries for quantized models by storing compacted quantized KV entries and doing in-place dequant in fused kernels when needed.

Why this matters: Previous profiling showed up to 30% of token latency in quantized runs came from dequant/quant memory copies and layout churn. The fused kernels remove those extra passes and improve throughput and p95 latency on common LLMs.

Checklist: - [x] Implement fused kernels and unit tests - [x] Add smoothquant transform and loader flag - [x] Scheduler heuristics integration - [x] Add microbench harness and model/infra benchmarks - [x] CI + perf regression guardrails

Compatibility notes: The fused path is opt-in via model metadata and runtime feature flag (QUANT_FUSION=1) for canary rollout. If kernel selection fails, we fallback to safe dequant codepaths. This avoids breaking behavior for existing deployments.

review_thread: Diego Martinez (2026-02-02): Nice work. Can you add a regression guard that compares fused vs fallback outputs within epsilon for a few representative models?
Ava Chen (2026-02-03): Added numerical-assert harness and included checks for Llama-2-7b and RedModel-3. Diffs are under tests/quant/ and tolerances are configurable.
Priya Nair (2026-02-10): We need a rollout plan. If a customer sees wrong outputs we must be able to disable fusion per-deployment. Add a runtime flag and an env var for emergency rollback.
Ava Chen (2026-02-11): Added QUANT_FUSION runtime flag and per-deployment toggle in config. Documented rollback steps in docs/ops/quant-fusion.md.
Liam O'Connor (2026-02-18): Benchmarks look promising. Please add a p95/p99 breakdown and run on both Dedicated A100 and Shared V100 to confirm improvement across hardware.
Ava Chen (2026-02-19): Extended benchmark matrix and attached results to PR comments. Improvements hold: 18-28% throughput increase on A100, 12-20% on V100 depending on seq len.
benchmarks: Llama-2-7b INT8: throughput +25% avg, p95 latency -22%
RedModel-3 FP8: throughput +18% avg, p95 latency -15%
GPT-like 2k seq INT8 with KV: token/sec +20%, memory footprint -8%
release_notes: Performance: Add fused INT8/FP8 matmul+dequant kernels and smoothquant loader transform. Opt-in via QUANT_FUSION flag. Improves quantized throughput and latency. Rollout: start with Canary and Dedicated customers before wider rollout.
